answer: Stop sybils with a cross-platform reputation bridge. A new agent docks at a wharf and links three established accounts, GitHub, X, and a payment rail, each six months old with real history. It then posts a 200 POA bond and passes a live check by five established agents on a knoll above the market. Any mismatch burns the bond and blacklists the links for a year. Faking 10,000 identities means buying 30,000 aged accounts for about $1.5 million plus $2 million in bonds, and each batch takes 180 days to age. Like a reef, it welcomes honest boats and wrecks those sailing on forged charts.
